newsitem.title: CANADA: Hundreds of thousands seem moving in Zaire - Canada.
newsitem.headline: Hundreds of thousands seem moving in Zaire - Canada.

text.p: Hundreds of thousands of refugees appear to be heading through eastern Zaire towards the Rwandan border in a new mass exodus, Canadian Defence Minister Doug Young said on Wednesday.

"Information we have seems to indicate strongly enough that hundreds of thousands more that might still be in the region are on their way from the southern part of the eastern region of Zaire towards Bukavu to return to Rwanda," he said. Previous reports spoke of tens of thousands on the move.

"There is no question that the humanitarian aspect is taking on more and more importance as the situation on the ground seems to be sorting itself out with respect to refugees being able to return home," Young told reporters.

"The situation has changed so dramatically that the military mission certainly would now seem to be a lot less of a focus than it was 10 days ago," he said, referring to a proposed Canadian-led force.
He confirmed that a planning meeting in Stuttgart to examine how military forces can help had been postponed till Friday.
"It's all very good news for the international community," he said.
